events.title: 스톡포트 카운티 set a Football League record of nine consecutive wins without conceding a goal by beating 스윈던 타운 3–0 at Edgeley Park . Goalkeeper 웨인 헤네시 keeps the club record nine consecutive clean sheets and is named Player of the Month for February 2007.
The new Wembley Stadium opens for a special community event.

맨체스터 유나이티드 now lead 첼시 by nine points, but have played one match more. 리버풀, 아스널 and Bolton are still in the mix for a Champions League place, with sixth-placed Reading and seventh-place 에버턴's challenge for UEFA Cup qualification is being threatened by 포츠머스 and 토트넘 홋스퍼. 위건 애슬레틱 remains six points ahead of eighteenth-placed Charlton, joined in the relegation zone by 웨스트햄 유나이티드 and 왓퍼드. Birmingham are back on top of the Championship, a point ahead of 웨스트브로미치 앨비언 and 더비 카운티. An improving 선덜랜드 have moved into the top six, ahead of 사우샘프턴 and Cardiff. The relegation zone is unchanged from the end of January.

첼시 have moved to within six points of leaders 맨체스터 유나이티드 but, with only seven matches left to play, there is little hope of the Londoners retaining the title for a third successive season. 리버풀 and 아스널 have put distance between Bolton in the chase for the Champions League, who complete the top seven with 에버턴 and 토트넘 홋스퍼. Charlton, 웨스트햄 유나이티드 and 왓퍼드 remain in the relegation zone but have caught up with strugglers 위건 애슬레틱 and 셰필드 유나이티드, now only three points and one point above the relegation zone respectively. 선덜랜드 have finally moved into the automatic promotion spots in the Championship, sandwiched by leaders 더비 카운티 and Birmingham. Preston, 웨스트브로미치 앨비언 and 울버햄프턴 원더러스 are in the play-off places. 루턴 타운 have slipped to the bottom of the table, behind Southend and Leeds.
